# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 2 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_002_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 2

**2:1** And his wife Anna mourned with two mournings and lamented with two lamentations, saying, "I will mourn my widowhood, and I will mourn my childlessness."

**2:2** And the great day of the Lord drew near, and Juthine her maidservant said to her, "How long do you humble your soul? Behold, the great day of the Lord has drawn near, and it is not lawful for you to mourn. But take this headband which the mistress of the workshop gave to me, and it is not lawful for me to put it on, because I am a maidservant and it bears a royal mark."

**2:3** And Anna said, "Depart from me. I have not done such things, and the Lord God has greatly humbled me. Perhaps a crafty one gave this to you, and you have come to make me partaker in your sin." And Juthine the maidservant said, "What shall I curse you with, since you have not listened to my voice? The Lord God has closed your womb so as not to give you fruit in Israel."

**2:4** And Anna was greatly grieved, and she put off her mourning garments and cleansed her head and put on her bridal garments; and about the ninth hour she went down into her garden to walk about. And she saw a laurel tree and sat down beneath it, and she prayed to the Lord saying, "O God of our fathers, bless me and listen to my prayer, as you blessed the womb of our mother Sarah and gave her a son, Isaac."
